li.p: Set the charging schedule for your vehicle from the infotainment system, Kia App, or Kia Connect app.
Set the charging schedule for your vehicle on the Infotainment system, Kia App, or Kia Connect app.
Scheduled charging operates only with a slow charger or a portable charger (ICCB: In Cable Control Box).
When scheduled charging is set and a slow charger or portable charger (ICCB: In Cable Control Box) is connected, the charging status indicator on the charging door will appear orange.
When scheduled charging is set, connecting a slow charger or portable charger (ICCB: In Cable Control Box) will not start charging immediately.
To start charging immediately, disable the scheduled charging setting through the infotainment system or the Kia App or Kia Connect app.
You can also press and hold the immediate charging switch for about 2 seconds to cancel scheduled charging and start charging immediately.
If scheduled charging is set, the system calculates the start time automatically. In some cases, charging may begin immediately after the charger is connected.
*: Depending on your region, this cable may not be provided in your vehicle.

note.p: The infotainment system may change after software updates. For more information, refer to the manual provided in the infotainment system and the quick reference guide.
